hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The cross-asset regime is risk_on, but the actionable evidence is weak: BTC and ETH are flat with negative composites, while SOL, LTC, and UNI show notably adverse alpha, factor, liquidity, or tail-risk characteristics. The identical long verdicts for XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, XLM, and ETC are fragile because their zero volatility, zero expected shortfall, and largely default factor inputs suggest incomplete or unreliable data rather than robust conviction. Maintain a defensive overlay and avoid treating those nominal longs as meaningful diversification.
